tools.name: web_crawl
tools.description: Traverse linked pages starting from one seed URL.

tools.name: web_query
tools.description: Plan and execute a goal-oriented query with optional seed URL. Discovery Memory is consulted first for seedless queries; web_search is public bootstrap fallback. Use same_site_links to expand from a seed site, and off only when seed_url is the exact canonical page.

examples.goal: Read the verified initialize method page

discovery_mode.description: Discovery strategy. same_site_links = follow links from the seed site. web_search = bootstrap with search. off = do not expand beyond the seed URL and should be used only after the exact page has already been verified.

goal.description: Retrieval objective or question to answer.

lane_max.description: Optional reasoning/escalation lane budget. Valid range is 0..4. Omit lane_max unless explicit budget control is needed; MCP clamps out-of-range values to the nearest valid value with a warning.

seed_url.description: Optional starting URL. If present, same_site_links expands from this site. When discovery_mode=off, this must be the exact canonical page and must already exist.

tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Read one URL and return compact proof-carrying context first. Successful reads automatically feed local Discovery Memory and Analytics PAL for future seedless reuse.

lane_max.description: Optional reasoning/escalation lane budget. Valid range is 0..4. Omit lane_max unless explicit budget control is needed; MCP clamps out-of-range values to the nearest valid value with a warning.

tools.name: web_replay
tools.description: Replay a stored trace and report deterministic stage completion.

tools.name: web_diff
tools.description: Compare two stored traces and report changed stages.

tools.name: web_proof
tools.description: Load proof records by trace id, proof id, or chunk id.

tools.name: web_prune
tools.description: Prune local traces, proofs, fingerprints, and genome files.

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Advanced non-core Discovery Memory control. Use only when explicitly inspecting or maintaining Needle-X local semantic memory; normal web retrieval already uses memory automatically. Actions: stats shows counts/freshness; search checks local semantic recall; prune applies retention policy; export/import move canonical JSONL rows; rebuild_index refreshes acceleration state.

action.description: Required operation. Prefer stats or search for debugging; prune/export/import/rebuild_index are maintenance actions.

tools.name: analytics
tools.description: Advanced non-core Analytics PAL control. Use only for diagnostics, value reporting, or maintenance; normal web_read/web_query/web_crawl record analytics automatically. Actions: value_report is the user-facing WOW report; stats/recent_runs are quick diagnostics; hosts/providers/failures/daily are maintainer rollups; export writes full analytics artifacts.

action.description: Required operation. Prefer value_report for product value, stats/recent_runs for quick debug, failures/providers for reliability analysis.

limit.description: Maximum rows for recent_runs, hosts, providers, failures, or daily.
